owner_requirement: Scheduling must also exist in the Digital Twin and be kept synchronized.
identity: The existing executor task ID is the Twin task ID; copying it must not create a second executor.

supported_calendar_subset.daily_or_weekly: single BYHOUR/BYMINUTE/BYSECOND; unnumbered BYDAY only for WEEKLY
supported_calendar_subset.hourly: elapsed UTC intervals anchored by DTSTART; BY filters unsupported
supported_calendar_subset.unsupported: Fail closed; never approximate unsupported COUNT, UNTIL, monthly, multi-hour or webhook schedules.

continuous_bridge_adapter.trigger: Existing source events, resume and restart/redelivery; no timer or second executor
continuous_bridge_adapter.durable_journal: Private schedule_bridge SQLite table; event ID binds exact original request
continuous_bridge_adapter.remote_mutation: Update existing task only, atomic source-domain CAS required
continuous_bridge_adapter.provider: Server-configured HttpScheduleExecutor; HTTPS or loopback HTTP; scoped expiring credential
continuous_bridge_adapter.source_read_contract: Closed scope envelope and fresh task/version/observed_at/conditional_update observation
continuous_bridge_adapter.source_version_binding: Exact configuration and updated_at; rollback and contradictory version bindings reject
continuous_bridge_adapter.idempotency: A replay freshly reads source; ATTEMPTED never resubmits an update
continuous_bridge_adapter.local_recovery: Journal revision changes atomically with reconcile; independent persisted task read
continuous_bridge_adapter.provider_without_cas: Observation only; changed desired configuration holds
continuous_bridge_adapter.verification_boundary: Test gateway proves adapter behavior only; actual provider authentication, CAS and event/restart carrier require fresh deployed-subject witnesses
